lines.heard: Here is the plan. Use the start to find P not, then use the doubling, then take LN.
lines.said: Here is the plan: use the start to find P nought, then use the doubling, then take L N.

lines.heard: He is involved, so take ln of both sides. Now the power can come down.
lines.said: E is involved, so take L N of both sides. Now the power can come down.

lines.heard: Bring the power down 7.5k comes down in front of LNE.
lines.said: Bring the power down: seven point five K comes down in front of L N E.

lines.heard: LN E is 1 because E to the power 1 is E. So 7.5K equals LN2.
lines.said: L N E is one, because E to the power one is E. So seven point five K equals L N two.

lines.heard: So K is 0.0924 correct to three significant figures.
lines.said: So K is zero point zero nine two four, correct to three significant figures.
